theorem disk_defect (q l : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    normSq (denominator q l z)-normSq (numerator q l z) =
      (1-l)^2*(1-q^2)*normSq (1+(q:ℂ)*z) +
      l^2*(1+q^2)^2*(1-normSq z) +
      2*l*(1-l)*(1+q^2)*(1-q^2*normSq z)

    (∫ p, bregman (density q t μ p.1) (density q t μ p.2) ∂(invariantLaw q) ⊗ₘ kernel q h) =

theorem generator_single (a : Wave → ℝ) (k : Wave) (c : ℂ) :
    generator a (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single k (-(a k : ℂ)*c)
def kernel (a : Wave → ℝ) (k l : Wave) : ℝ

def gammaIter (a : Wave → ℝ) : ℕ → Fourier → Fourier → Fourier
  | 0, f, g => reflection f * g
  | n+1, f, g => (1/2 : ℂ) •
      (generator a (gammaIter a n f g) - gammaIter a n (generator a f) g -
        gammaIter a n f (generator a g))

theorem gammaIter_single (a : Wave → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (k l : Wave) (c d : ℂ) :
    gammaIter a n (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single l d) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (l-k) ((kernel a k l : ℂ)^n * conj c * d)

theorem gammaIter_single (a : Wave → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (k l : Wave) (c d : ℂ) :
    gammaIter a n (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single l d) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (l-k) ((kernel a k l : ℂ)^n * conj c * d)

theorem gammaIter_finite {ι κ : Type*} (a : Wave → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (k : ι → Wave) (l : κ → Wave)
    (c : ι → ℂ) (d : κ → ℂ) :
    gammaIter a n (∑ i ∈ s, AddMonoidAlgebra.single (k i) (c i))
      (∑ j ∈ t, AddMonoidAlgebra.single (l j) (d j)) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, AddMonoidAlgebra.single (l j-k i)
        ((kernel a (k i) (l j) : ℂ)^n * conj (c i) * d j)

theorem drift_lower_coefficient (n m : ℤ) :
    (m-n) * twiceKernel n m + n * twiceKernel (n+1) m -
      m * twiceKernel n (m-1) = twiceKernel n m

theorem drift_upper_coefficient (n m : ℤ) :
    -(m-n) * twiceKernel n m - n * twiceKernel (n-1) m +
      m * twiceKernel n (m+1) = twiceKernel n m

theorem cauchy_kernel_twice (k l : Wave) :
    kernel (stableSymbol 1) k l = (twiceKernel (k 0) (l 0) : ℝ)/2

theorem transport_product (f g : Fourier) :
    transport (f*g) = f * transport g + g * transport f

theorem transport_single (k : Wave) (c : ℂ) :
    transport (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (k-unitWave) ((k 0 : ℂ)/2*c) -
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (k+unitWave) ((k 0 : ℂ)/2*c)

theorem transport_synthesis (f : Fourier) (x : FiniteFourierSynthesis.Space) :
    FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (transport f) =
      -(Real.sin (x 0) : ℂ) * FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (dLinear 0 f)

theorem transport_reflection (f : Fourier) :
    reflection (transport f) = transport (reflection f)
noncomputable def firstGamma (L : Fourier → Fourier) (f g : Fourier) : Fourier
noncomputable def secondGamma (L : Fourier → Fourier) (f g : Fourier) : Fourier

theorem drift_secondGamma_correction (a : Wave → ℝ) (f g : Fourier) :
     secondGamma (fun h => generator a h + transport h) f g =
       gammaIter a 2 f g + (1/2 : ℂ) •
         (transport (gammaIter a 1 f g) - gammaIter a 1 (transport f) g -
           gammaIter a 1 f (transport g))

theorem kernel_lower (k l : Wave) :
    ((l 0 : ℂ)-(k 0 : ℂ)) * (kernel (stableSymbol 1) k l : ℂ) +
      (k 0 : ℂ) * (kernel (stableSymbol 1) (k+unitWave) l : ℂ) -
      (l 0 : ℂ) * (kernel (stableSymbol 1) k (l-unitWave) : ℂ) =
        (kernel (stableSymbol 1) k l : ℂ)

theorem kernel_upper (k l : Wave) :
    -((l 0 : ℂ)-(k 0 : ℂ)) * (kernel (stableSymbol 1) k l : ℂ) -
      (k 0 : ℂ) * (kernel (stableSymbol 1) (k-unitWave) l : ℂ) +
      (l 0 : ℂ) * (kernel (stableSymbol 1) k (l+unitWave) : ℂ) =
        (kernel (stableSymbol 1) k l : ℂ)

theorem drift_bracket_single (k l : Wave) (c d : ℂ) :
    transport (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c)
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single l d)) -
      gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (transport (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c))
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single l d) -
      gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c)
        (transport (AddMonoidAlgebra.single l d)) =
      (1/2 : ℂ) • (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (l-k-unitWave)
        ((kernel (stableSymbol 1) k l : ℂ)*conj c*d) +
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single (l-k+unitWave)
        ((kernel (stableSymbol 1) k l : ℂ)*conj c*d))

theorem drift_bracket (f g : Fourier) :
    transport (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 f g) -
      gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (transport f) g -
      gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 f (transport g) =
        cosineMultiplier * gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 f g

theorem cauchy_drift_scalar_shift_synthesis (f g : Fourier)
    (x : FiniteFourierSynthesis.Space) :
    FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x
      (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h + transport h) f g) =
    FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 f g) +
      ((Real.cos (x 0) : ℂ)/2) *
        FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 f g)

theorem firstGamma_scaled_transport (r : ℝ) (L : Fourier → Fourier) (f g : Fourier) :
    firstGamma (fun h => L h + r • transport h) f g = firstGamma L f g

theorem cauchy_scaled_drift_scalar_shift_synthesis (r : ℝ) (f g : Fourier)
    (x : FiniteFourierSynthesis.Space) :
    FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x
      (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h + r • transport h) f g) =
    FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 f g) +
      ((r * Real.cos (x 0) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 f g)

theorem harmonic_product (r : ℤ) (f g : Fourier) :
    (harmonic r) (f*g) = f * (harmonic r) g + g * (harmonic r) f

theorem harmonic_general_single (r : ℤ) (k : Wave) (c : ℂ) :
    (harmonic r) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single k c) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (k-(wave r)) ((k 0 : ℂ)/2*c) -
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (k+(wave r)) ((k 0 : ℂ)/2*c)

theorem harmonic_reflection (r : ℤ) (f : Fourier) :
    reflection ((harmonic r) f) = (harmonic r) (reflection f)

theorem firstGamma_harmonic_invariant (r : ℤ) (L : Fourier → Fourier) (f g : Fourier) :
     firstGamma (fun h => L h + (harmonic r) h) f g = firstGamma L f g

theorem action_axis (r n : ℤ) (c : ℂ) :
    harmonic r (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (wave n) c) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (wave (n-r)) ((n:ℂ)/2*c) -
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (wave (n+r)) ((n:ℂ)/2*c)

theorem kernel_axis (n m : ℤ) :
    (kernel (stableSymbol 1) (wave n) (wave m):ℂ) = (((|n|+|m|-|m-n|:ℤ):ℂ)/2)

theorem kernel_difference (n r : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    kernel (stableSymbol 1) (wave (n+r)) (wave n) -
      kernel (stableSymbol 1) (wave (n-r)) (wave n) = ((min n r:ℤ):ℝ)

theorem diagonal_bracket (n r : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    bracket r (mode n) (mode n) = ((n:ℂ)*(min n r:ℤ)/2) • (mode r+mode (-r))

theorem harmonic_synthesis (r : ℤ) (f : Fourier) (x : FiniteFourierSynthesis.Space) :
    FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (harmonic r f) =
      -(Real.sin ((r:ℝ)*x 0):ℂ)*FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (dLinear 0 f)

theorem second_correction (r : ℤ) (f g : Fourier) :
    secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) f g =
      gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 f g + (1/2:ℂ) • bracket r f g

theorem diagonal_correction (n r : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) (mode n) (mode n) -
      gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 (mode n) (mode n) =
        ((n:ℂ)*(min n r:ℤ)/4) • (mode r+mode (-r))

theorem gamma_diagonal (n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (mode n) (mode n) = (n:ℂ) • mode 0

theorem correction_at_zero (n r : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis 0
      (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) (mode n) (mode n) -
        gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 (mode n) (mode n)) = (n:ℂ)*(min n r:ℤ)/2

theorem no_positive_mode_scalar (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 < r) :
    ¬ ∃ a : ℂ, ∀ n : ℤ, 0 < n →
      FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis 0
        (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) (mode n) (mode n) -
          gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 (mode n) (mode n)) =
        a*FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis 0 (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (mode n) (mode n))

theorem scalar_iff (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (∃ a : FiniteFourierSynthesis.Space → ℂ, ∀ f : Fourier, ∀ x,
      FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x
        (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) f f -
          gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 f f) =
        a x*FiniteFourierSynthesis.synthesis x (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 f f)) ↔
      r = 0 ∨ r = 1
theorem pair_hermitian (n : ℤ) : Hermitian (pair n)

theorem gamma_pair_zero (n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    synthesis 0 (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (pair n) (pair n)) = (2:ℂ)*n

theorem pair_correction_at_zero (n r : ℤ) :
    synthesis 0
      (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) (pair n) (pair n) -
        gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 (pair n) (pair n)) =
      -(1/2:ℂ)*synthesis 0 (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (harmonic r (pair n)) (pair n)) -
       (1/2:ℂ)*synthesis 0 (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 (pair n) (harmonic r (pair n)))

theorem pair_one_correction (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    synthesis 0
      (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) (pair 1) (pair 1) -
        gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 (pair 1) (pair 1)) = 0

theorem pair_harmonic_correction (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    synthesis 0
      (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) (pair r) (pair r) -
        gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 (pair r) (pair r)) = (r:ℂ)^2

theorem pair_synthesis (n : ℤ) (x : Space) :

theorem no_real_scalar_at_zero (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ¬ ∃ a : ℂ, ∀ f : Fourier, Hermitian f →
      synthesis 0
        (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) f f -

theorem real_scalar_iff (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :

      synthesis x
        (secondGamma (fun h => generator (stableSymbol 1) h+harmonic r h) f f -
          gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 2 f f) = a x*synthesis x (gammaIter (stableSymbol 1) 1 f f)) ↔
